selection_note: The R257/R299 strategy, result and some exploratory segment/year attribution were already inspected before this protocol was written. This is an explicitly post-hoc descriptive audit, not blind or independent validation and not evidence of a new alpha.
question: Within the two already-frozen R299 discovery and validation segments, does the original stock-level net-P&L concentration failure persist in both segments?
source: R299's existing corrected-cost StrategyBacktestService trade records only; no new backtest

analysis.unit: closed trade P&L grouped by symbol within each frozen segment
analysis.annual_slice_handling: Optional descriptive entry-calendar-year trade attribution only; not annual portfolio returns. Original C2-C4 are evaluated only for a positive net-P&L slice.

decision_rules.C2: top1 positive symbol net P&L / segment total net P&L <= 0.25, only if total net P&L > 0
decision_rules.C3: top3 positive symbol net P&L / segment total net P&L <= 0.55, only if total net P&L > 0
decision_rules.C4: top5 positive symbol net P&L / segment total net P&L <= 0.75, only if total net P&L > 0
decision_rules.non_positive_net_pnl_slice: C2-C4 not applicable; report the net P&L and do not substitute a denominator
